name.zh: 野銀的水芋田長輩：補種芋苗
name.en: Ivalino taro field elder: replant taro shoots

text.unlockEn: Trust of the taro field elder

steps.text: 野銀的水芋田長輩請你幫忙補種
steps.textEn: The Ivalino taro field elder asks you to help replant

lines.zh: 前幾天採收了，空出來的地方要補種。這幾株芋苗拿去，插進泥巴裡。
lines.en: We harvested a few days ago, and the empty spots need replanting. Take these taro shoots and push them into the mud.

lines.zh: 田裡的事，我們女人最清楚。跟著我做就對了。
lines.en: We women know the fields best. Just follow me.

steps.text: 到野銀水芋田，把芋苗插進泥裡
steps.textEn: Go to the Ivalino taro field and push the taro shoots into the mud

lines.zh: 泥巴好深，腳都陷進去了！
lines.en: The mud's so deep, my feet are sinking!

steps.textEn: Report to the taro field elder

lines.zh: 種得很好。等它長大，要好幾個月呢。水要一直流，芋頭才會好吃。
lines.en: Nicely planted. It'll be a few months before it's grown. The water has to keep flowing, or the taro won't taste good.

hint.zh: 野銀的水芋田長輩採收後要補種芋苗。
hint.en: After the harvest, the Ivalino taro field elder needs to replant taro shoots.

name.zh: 野銀的長輩：飛魚季的規矩
name.en: Ivalino elder: the rules of flying fish season

review: 飛魚季規矩與漁獲分配的公開程度

steps.text: 聽野銀的長輩說飛魚季的規矩
steps.textEn: Hear the Ivalino elder explain the rules of flying fish season

lines.zh: 飛魚季的時候，什麼時候出海、魚怎麼分，是我們男人一起商量的。
lines.en: In flying fish season, when to go to sea and how to share the fish are decided by the men together.

lines.zh: 一條船回來，魚先分給船組，再分給親戚。行動不方便的長輩，也不會被忘記。
lines.en: When a boat comes back, the fish go to the crew first, then to relatives. Elders who can't get around aren't forgotten either.

lines.zh: 飛魚季結束了，就停下來，讓魚回去。這是對海的禮。
lines.en: When flying fish season ends, we stop and let the fish go back. That's our respect for the sea.

lines.zh: 能公開的規矩只有一部分，各部落也不一樣，還要請族人確認。
lines.en: Only some of the rules can be shared, and each village is different. This still needs checking with the community.

toastEn: "Flying fish season rules" was added to your notebook.

hint.zh: 飛魚季時，野銀的長輩會說說飛魚季的規矩。
hint.en: In flying fish season, the Ivalino elder will talk about its rules.
